parameters.description:
`msg-to-postmark-email` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your Postmark Email destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through a native gateway transformation that posts straight to your own Postmark Email destinations — free, and driven entirely by the credentials you have stored. Paid variants ($0.001 / message) deliver to additional Postmark Email destinations bound per enrollment.

Sign in at account.postmarkapp.com, select (or create) a Server, then open its API Tokens page and copy the Server API Token into POSTMARK_SERVER_TOKEN. Under Sender Signatures, verify the address or domain you want to send from and set it as POSTMARK_FROM_EMAIL, then set the recipient's address as POSTMARK_TO_EMAIL.
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment Postmark destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to Postmark email API
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own Postmark Email destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

from_email_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's POSTMARK_FROM_EMAIL value (same format as POSTMARK_FROM_EMAIL)

server_token_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's POSTMARK_SERVER_TOKEN value (same format as POSTMARK_SERVER_TOKEN)

to_email_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's POSTMARK_TO_EMAIL value (same format as POSTMARK_TO_EMAIL)
